plans.objective: [DIM: structure] The rigid family is defined by the linear PDE $f''(x) = 0$ (linear functions $f(x) = ax+b$) with $w \ge 2$, while the fat family is defined by the high-dimensional polynomial space of degree up to 10 with random coefficients, leading to unbounded solution dimension and zero violation unreachability at $h=64$.

steps.description: Implement the family function for the rigid family (linear PDE f''(x)=0) and fat family (high-dimensional polynomial space) to test the bootstrap capacity scan hypothesis. The rigid family will generate linear functions with w constraints, while the fat family will generate degree-10 polynomials with random coefficients. Both families need proper normalization to O(1) scale and (N,1) shaped outputs for X, y, Xv, yv.
